text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High 502 rate observed on apigw-edge (eu-west-1). 5xx spike detected — ~1.3k errors in the last 2m. SLO alert triggered (P1).
olivia: Ack, I’m on it — paging SRE oncall and infra.
olivia: Quick check — did we have any config or routing deploy ~10m ago?
dinesh: Looking at deploys now — nothing obvious in service CI. However mux-proxy logs show spikes in connection resets and upstream 502s. /v1/generate is the top offender.
maria: Customer impact: support seeing multiple errors from enterprise tenants in EU, roughly 15% failure rate for some orgs. Support escalation started.
sam: Can we temp-route eu-west traffic to eu-central as an immediate fallback? Will add latency but may reduce customer errors.
olivia: Before we reroute, try disabling the recent mux experiment flag — it coincides with the timeline and affects fanout.
dinesh: Rolling back mux_experiment flag now:
```
curl -XPOST "https://configctl.internal/api/flags/mux_experiment/rollback" -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx"
```
incident-bot: Action logged: flag rollback requested by dinesh.
maria: Support notes: created ticket INC-8421, prepped a customer-facing status blurb in #support-desk (will publish after stability).
dinesh: Flag rollback complete. Watching metrics and proxy logs for changes.
sam: Also enabling circuit breaker for backend-pool-3 to reduce fanout amplification:
```
trafficctl set-cb --pool backend-pool-3 --threshold 10 --duration 30s
```
olivia: ✅ After rollback + circuit breaker, 502 rate dropped from ~1300/min -> ~180/min over 5m window. Latency holding. Keep monitors on.
maria: Support update: major accounts retrying successfully, drafting status page update for customers — will post once stable for 15m.
kirti: I’ll take a 30m watch and follow up. Handing off oncall to me in 5. I’ll create the initial postmortem skeleton and add owners.
olivia: Handing to kirti for overnight watch. If 502s spike again, escalate to infra and prepare hotfix deploy. :thumbsup: 
kirti: Ack, watching dashboards and logs. I’ll trigger hotfix job if errors >500/min for 10m. Documenting runbook steps in incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/3887654322
olivia: Closing active pager for now, still monitoring in-thread. Final quick summary: peak ~1.3k 502/min -> baseline ~20/min after mitigations. Action items: postmortem, stress-test mux-proxy under high fanout, add automated rollback trigger for risky flags, update runbook. :white_check_mark:
